verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a financial platform. The only relevant evidence is the official CLI, which can 'read and write your Airwallex resources' and 'script repeatable tasks' across a broad slice of the API, so a user could build their own data extraction as a workaround. Nothing documents a dedicated export feature, open file formats, or account offboarding. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account data export, open export formats (CSV/JSON statements, transaction history), coverage of all data types, account closure/portability guidance, independent corroboration.
